title: Majestic Bishop
reviewNotes: Five branches, 18 exact positions from the complete five-piece source root. c7 ...Bb8 c8=B ...Bf4 Nd7 ...Be3 Bb7# is actual mate. Queen and rook promotion each stalemate. Capturing the offered bishop leads to king-and-knight draw, while knight promotion and the illustrated ...Bf4 Nb6+ ...Kb8 Ncd7+ ...Kc7 route also draw. All four straight promotion choices are checked.
